name: Graywater's Fixer
oracle_text: Each outlaw creature card in your graveyard has encore {X}, where X is its mana value. (Exile it and pay its encore cost: For each opponent, create a token copy that attacks that opponent this turn if able. They gain haste. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step. Activate only as a sorcery.)
blocked_sentences: Each outlaw creature card in your graveyard has encore {X}, where X is its mana value

needs.what: a static that grants encore to cards in your graveyard matching a filter (creature cards with an outlaw subtype: Assassin, Mercenary, Pirate, Rogue, Warlock), with the encore cost set per card to generic mana equal to that card's own mana value; encore itself being a graveyard-activated, sorcery-speed ability whose cost exiles the card and whose effect creates, for each opponent, a token copy of it with haste that must attack that opponent this turn and is sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step
needs.why_existing_wont_do: There is no encore keyword or card-level cost key; the grant_ability static only reaches permanents (a granted activated ability works on the battlefield only), cast_from_graveyard/grant_graveyard_cast give cast permissions rather than an activated ability, and no cost or value can price an ability at the mana value of the card it is granted to
